description: TikTok Smart+ VALUE RULES: bid MORE (up to +50%) or LESS (down to -70%) for people matching criteria such as gender, age, location, iOS or Android, or an audience, so an ad group pays up for the customers worth more. action "list" (default, free) reads the ad account’s rule sets with their rules; "create" makes one (name + 1-10 rules; the first matching rule wins); "update" and "delete" change a set that may already steer live bids, so both need confirm:true after the user agrees. Attach a set with create_tiktok_smart_ad_group valueRuleSetId. Creating rule sets is ALLOWLIST-ONLY at TikTok and the reply says so when TikTok refuses. Up to 20 sets per ad account. Every change is read back from TikTok.

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

confirm.description: true after the user agreed to an update or delete

name.description: create (required, unique on the ad account) or update: the rule set name, up to 512 characters

ruleSetId.description: update / delete: the rule set id from action list

rules.description: create / update: 1-10 rules, each with up to TWO criteria (a person must match both)

name: manage_tiktok_smart_value_rules
title: TikTok Smart+ value rules (bid adjustments)
